Package io.jans.fido2.service.readiness

Class WellKnownFetchResult

java.lang.Object
io.jans.fido2.service.readiness.WellKnownFetchResult
public final class WellKnownFetchResult extends Object
What WellKnownFetcher got back from a relying party's server.

Either a WellKnownFetchResult.Failure (nothing usable came back) or an HTTP response. A redirect is a response: its status and Location are reported as data and never followed. Failures are coarse on purpose, so that a caller cannot use them to probe what is reachable from the server's network.
